description: Work (a composition, distinct from a recording) by MBID: type, languages, ISWCs, writers/composers/lyricists, movements, arrangements, aliases, tags, and external links. Follow work target MBIDs with this tool; direction, orderingKey, and targetDisambiguation distinguish parts and arrangements without reordering relationships. This server returns the first 25 recording relationships with their exact total and actual truncation disclosure, preserving all other relationships. Browse recording entities with musicbrainz_browse_entities (target_type=recording, link.work), then use musicbrainz_get_recording for work relationship attributes and dates; browse alone does not return those details.

inc_relationships.description: Include writer/composer, movement/arrangement and recording relationships, and external links.

mbid.description: Work MBID (hyphenated hexadecimal UUID; surrounding whitespace and uppercase accepted).

name: musicbrainz_get_work

items.description: An alternate name for the entity.

locale.description: BCP-47 locale of the alias. Omitted when absent.

primary.description: Whether this is the primary alias for its locale. Omitted when absent.

sortName.description: Sortable form of the alias. Omitted when absent.

type.description: Alias type (e.g. "Artist name", "Legal name"). Omitted when absent.

cap.description: Server-side recording relationship cap, when truncated.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_mbid`: The MBID is malformed or the all-zeros sentinel (rejected before fetch), or MusicBrainz rejects it with HTTP 400. `entity_not_found`: The MBID is well-formed but no work exists with it (MusicBrainz returns HTTP 404). Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

items.description: An external resource link (url-rel). Where cross-service IDs like Wikidata QID are surfaced.

resource.description: The external URL. Wikidata/Discogs IDs live in the URL path — chain to those servers.

iswcs.description: ISWCs assigned to this work (may be empty).

languages.description: Lyrics languages (ISO codes; may be empty).

notice.description: Recording enumeration and relationship-detail retrieval guidance when truncated.

relationships.description: All non-recording relationships and the first 25 recording relationships in upstream order (may be empty).

items.description: A typed relationship to another entity (band membership, performer, writer, etc.).

attributes.description: Role modifiers (e.g. "lead vocals", "assistant", "co"). Omitted when none.

begin.description: Relationship start date. Omitted when absent.

end.description: Relationship end date. Omitted when absent.

orderingKey.description: Upstream relationship sequence key, including zero. Omitted when unknown; array order is preserved.

targetDisambiguation.description: Qualifier distinguishing the related entity from namesakes. Omitted when absent.

targetId.description: MBID of the related entity — chain to the matching get_* tool. Omitted for url targets.

targetName.description: Name/title of the related entity. Omitted when absent.

shown.description: Number of recording relationships returned when truncated.

items.description: A folksonomy tag or genre with its vote count.

count.description: Community vote count for this tag.

totalCount.description: Exact number of recording relationships before the server-side slice. Absent when relationships are disabled.

truncated.description: True only when recording relationships were omitted beyond 25.

type.description: Work type (Song, Symphony, …). Omitted when unknown.

title: musicbrainz-mcp-server: get work
